title: Approximation of Probability Geometries via Convex Families of Coordinate Charts
summary: Within probability-coordinate geometry, a continuous distribution function restricted to an interval can serve as a probability coordinate chart. Averaging in these coordinates defines probability barycenters and associated Kolmogorov moments. Because the class of admissible charts is infinite dimensional, this paper develops a finite-dimensional approximation theory. Relative to a fixed base chart, every chart on the same interval is represented uniquely by a strictly increasing deformation of the unit interval.
